def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    # Shapes are hollow rectangles: preserve frame color, fill interior with color 2; small 3x3 hollow shapes get center 7.
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        col=g[r][c]
        if col in (6,9) or (r,c) in seen: continue
        # connected same-colored component
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and g[yy][xx]==col and (yy,xx) not in seen:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
        t,b,l,rr=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        # fill strictly enclosed holes
        if b-t>=2 and rr-l>=2:
          fill=7 if (b-t==2 and rr-l==2) else 2
          for y in range(t+1,b):
            for x in range(l+1,rr):
              if g[y][x] not in (col,): g[y][x]=fill
    return g
PY

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Fill each hollow rectangular frame's interior. Demonstrations establish
    # fill 7 for odd-by-odd frame dimensions and fill 2 for even frame dimensions.
    from collections import Counter
    background=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=g[r][c]
            if color==background or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]
            seen.add((r,c))
            cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if (0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and g[yy][xx]==color
                            and (yy,xx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            ys=[y for y,x in cells]
            xs=[x for y,x in cells]
            top,bottom=min(ys),max(ys)
            left,right=min(xs),max(xs)
            fill=7 if (bottom-top+1)%2==1 and (right-left+1)%2==1 else 2
            for y in range(top+1,bottom):
                for x in range(left+1,right):
                    if g[y][x]!=color:
                        g[y][x]=fill
    return g
